title: HOMONYM
subtitle: Words change worlds — a spoken and visual relay around 'LINE'
lineage: Primary: SCION 055 (Words) · Supporting: SCION 092 (Hands of Bresson)
theorem: Construct a relay around one word with three visually legible senses. Establish its first use in an intact spoken context, let an action carry the next meaning before another voice names it, make the third sense alter the stakes, and return to the opening utterance.
boundary_note: Each spoken clip preserves the speaker's intact archival sentence rather than fabricating a stitched statement.

v1_defect_timecodes: Seg #03 (t=09.00s-14.80s): `12f71021` (`Freedom Seven`, 1961) cuts at 5.46s from the speakers to an aircraft carrier exterior.
critic_tribunal.largest_gap: The 5.8s duration on `12f71021` extended 0.54s past the internal cut at 5.46s.
critic_tribunal.causal_hypothesis: Clean window of `12f71021` is `0.05s-5.46s`; `in_s=0.2, dur=5.8` reached `6.0s`.
critic_tribunal.falsifiable_repair: Clamp `12f71021` in Seg #03 and Seg #09 to `in_s=0.1, dur=5.1` so it stays completely inside `0.05s-5.46s` without ever cutting to the aircraft carrier.
critic_tribunal.strength_to_preserve: The three-sense progression around 'LINE' (`f247b2aa` weather contour -> `12f71021` flight path line -> `aeebdc87` assembly line -> `7683b7a2`/`116af359` telephone line -> `74864d7a` hazard line -> `30fe8bbc` clothesline -> `12f71021` return).
